priorityCandidates.finding: 42 treated,40 response-evaluable (one consent withdrawal and one early progression excluded). Table 2 combines a40-person header with survival estimates while methods define FAS/PPS without clearly mapping reported PFS to an analysis denominator. Registry last updated 2022-12-02 describes single-center planned 68 versus paper multicenter planned 43/actual 42; no updated public amendment verified. Keep unresolved rather than infer a PFS analysis set or reproduce cross-trial superiority claims. Supplement download returned HTML instead of DOCX.

Single-arm phase II, 45 patients; abstract reports failure of the prespecified 36-month hepatic disease-free survival hypothesis, with clinically relevant biliary toxicity. Preserve this negative lead. Full eligibility, analysis sets, endpoint/censoring methods and adverse-event detail remain unverified; do not present abstract results as a full-paper-reviewed record.

Reported ORR pools 20 evaluable MSI-H or MSS/TMB-high GI patients across histologies and monotherapy/combination cohorts;8 responses include only 5 confirmed. The 40% figure is not CRC-specific. Require a CRC-specific denominator, confirmed-response accounting, timepoints and complete safety before curation. Nov 10 webinar is not first data release.

Historical August retrospective development/validation study newly indexed. Moderate external discrimination and inconsistent DFS associations are exploratory; not evidence that imaging can safely replace surgery or guide a treatment change. Retain as lower-priority methodological lead.

Historical August retrospective 178-patient cohort newly indexed.45 versus133 are pre-matching counts; do not infer matched denominators, causal superiority or long-term oncological equivalence from short-term findings.

Single-center retrospective CGP testing study. Actionable/discordant genomic findings do not establish clinical benefit from testing or a treatment regimen. Full plasma/tissue denominators and treatment-history confounding need review before quantitative curation.

PRECISION: manuscript eligibility and four denominator stages verified; primary feasibility endpoint, retrospective MRD, exploratory associations, nonrandomized treatment,20 GALAXY-overlapping participants explicitly distinguished. No test-guided benefit asserted.

Society recap adds preliminary mixed-tumor phase II description, not a complete CRC-specific source. Underlying abstract and safety remain incomplete. Existing pending record retained, not confused with terminated Alaunos phase I NCT05194735.

Real-world retrospective 946-patient TAS102/TAS-Bev biomarker cohort, first indexedDec 2025, May 2026 issue. Metadata hit is not a new randomized SUNLIGHT result; no existing trial conclusion changed.
